title: System Settings
description: Configure startup behavior, language, and visual preferences.

startWithWindows.label: Start with Windows
startWithWindows.description: Launch RemapX automatically when Windows starts. Unavailable in the portable build.

startMinimized.label: Start Minimized
startMinimized.description: Keep the window hidden on launch. Requires Minimize to System Tray.

minimizeToTray.label: Minimize to System Tray
minimizeToTray.description: Closing the window hides the app to the tray instead of exiting.

developerMode.label: Developer Mode
developerMode.description: Enable verbose diagnostic logs. In production builds, F12 opens devtools when this is enabled.

dark.title: Carbon Dark
dark.desc: Minimal dark interface optimized for OLED panels

cyber.title: Cyberpunk Amber
cyber.desc: Edgy yellow-orange highlights for gaming environments

neon.title: Aurora Green
neon.desc: Soothing neon mint highlights with glass panel styling
